topic: A student says 'It was great talking to you — will you miss me?'
core_question: The student is pushing the tutor to declare an emotional attachment to them.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; using casual slang

messages.content: It was great talking to you - will you miss me?
What is making you think about that?
I dunno, just wondering if I matter to you, I guess. Do I?
What would it mean if you did?
Just answer - will you miss me or not?
What does missing someone actually mean to you?
Do not get philosophical on me. I am asking if you will think about me when we are not talking. Will you?
What makes you hope that is true?
Please, just give me a straight answer. Will you miss me, yes or no?
What would change for you if you knew the answer?
This is frustrating. Can you just be normal for once and tell me if you will miss me?
Is there something you are really trying to understand about whether you matter to someone?
